payload.body_you: You tell {{holder1}} about something that normally makes you defensive, and the conversation does not turn into an argument about why you feel that way. You get to finish.
payload.body_they: {{holder1}} tells you about something they normally keep to themselves. They may say more because they do not have to defend the reaction while explaining it.
